tool_args.rationale: Pilot signatures support the smooth base-field/sink-gradient mechanism, but narrow s_grad range prevents identifying the heterogeneous rho parameter. The supplied branch guidance explicitly recommends the open-branch probe first and fitting across the wide fallback rho range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit hydraulic basin siphon law directly from five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The rows vary u_now but have only 0.016 s_grad span; vmax and rho are collinear, so rho is not identifiable.
The ambiguity flagged by the supplied guidance is specifically resolved more cheaply by wide s_grad leverage.
H=0.6 matches the target horizon, and the evidence indicates branch/sink identifiability rather than temporal-horizon ambiguity.
No evidence indicates nuisance variation; it is explicitly an irrelevant, more expensive probe.
